line_items.work_text: Approval to SDRF proposals of Irrigation department for the year 2022-23

Utilization of Balance Fund of Rs. 1254.97874 lakhs under capacity building component of ASDMA for either Setting up of a world class International Centre for Disaster Risk Mitigation at IIT Guwahati or Implementation of platform technologies for coordinated multi-hazard early warning and disaster response including capacity building

narrative: SEC authorized the Chief Executive Officer of ASDMA to approve the SOP for Automatic River Water Level Monitoring System (JAL TARANGINI). SEC approved 11 projects of irrigation department under SDRF for the year 2022-23. SEC asked ASDMA to place the matter in the next SEC meeting with detail cost benefit and alternative scheme.
